summary: GP-Act III Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing non-redemption agreements with third-party investors to secure 8,074,387 Class A ordinary shares from redemption and votes in favor of an extension amendment at an extraordinary general meeting. Sponsor HoldCo will transfer 403,720 Class A shares to these investors after a business combination closes. No price per share or premium is stated. The filing covers the entry into material definitive agreements, an amendment to articles, and shareholder votes. This is a SPAC seeking to extend its timeline to complete a de-SPAC merger. Watch for the approval of amendments and subsequent business combination announcement.
